text:
Alex: morning handoff — I'm on call until 20:00 PST. Quick bullets:
- Deploy 3.2.1 rolled out starting 05:10, full rollout completed ~06:05. No rollback. :tada:
- Observability: saw tail-latency spikes on embed-service around 02:40–03:15 (p95 up ~450ms). Alert cleared automatically.
- KV cache eviction experiment scheduled at 14:00 PT (will run for 2h) — watch cache-miss-rate and latency.
- Model swap for nightly inference (gpt-small -> gpt-medium-quant) is set for 01:00 UTC tomorrow; Priya is primary for that.
- No open incidents. Leaving a few action items below.

Jamie: thanks — can you confirm if the spike correlated with any config changes or traffic pattern?

Alex: yes, it lines up with a change in batching config pushed in PR #4827 (reduced max_batch_wait_ms from 12 -> 6). We reverted that value on the canary at 03:25 which helped. Full rollback happened with the deploy.

Priya: heads up I'll be offline from 15:30–18:00 PT; Jamie, can you cover the model swap window if anything blocks?

Jamie: I can cover. Can you drop the exact runbook link and the set of checks to run?

Priya: runbook here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/model-swap. Quick checks — health endpoints, sample-inference smoke test, kv hit-rate > 98%, queue length < 50. Also confirm fallback route is enabled.

Morgan: tagging the observability alert playbook too: https://confluence.redwood.ai/playbooks/obs-latency. If you see p95 > 400ms for >10m, escalate to oncall SRE.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Scheduled KV eviction experiment in eng-oncall at 14:00 PT today. (maintenance id: kv-evict-2026-03-17)

Alex: action items:
- Alex: monitor embed-service and keep the rollback path ready (I’ll stay online until 08:30 PT today).
- Jamie: cover Priya's 15:30–18:00 window and be ready for model-swap escalation.
- Priya: kick off model swap dry-run tonight 22:30 PT and post results.
- Morgan: validate alert thresholds post-experiment, leave notes in the experiment ticket.

Jamie: noted. I'll ping in this thread if I see any abnormalities during the eviction test.

Priya: added — I'll post the dry-run logs after 22:30. If anything blocks, I'll @Jamie and @Alex. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Alex: small FYI — a couple of tokenization-related 5xxs showed up on a low-traffic customer yesterday (ticket #4128). I filed a follow-up with the model team; not critical for oncall but flagging in case it reappears.

Morgan: thanks. I'll add #4128 to the watchlist and make sure the dashboard panels include that error class.

Jamie: 👍 all set from my side. Switching to oncall watchlist now.

Alex: handing off — see you all.
